note: Two live keyless recordings of the SAME chain catalogue under two different naming vocabularies. GET /chains is the legacy listing and is the vocabulary GET /protocols speaks (Optimism, Binance, xDai, zkSync Era); GET /v2/chains is the current one and is what registry.data.json's vendors.defillama column carries (OP Mainnet, BSC, Gnosis, ZKsync Era). Chain-level tvl was dropped on recording: it is a moving number, and pinning it would make this artifact's hash churn for a reason unrelated to what it is evidence of.
